celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الم﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ i.e. these verses ﴿آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Qurʾān ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾ possessed of wisdom; the annexation (iḍāfa) is in the sense of مِنْ. It is

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾ in the nominative ﴿لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾; and in the reading of the generality [of readers] [هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً] in the accusative, as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الآيات, its governing word (ʿāmil) being the sense of pointing contained in تِلْكَ.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَوةَ﴾ an explanation (bayān) of الْمُحْسِنِينَ, ﴿وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَوةَ وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ﴾ the second هُمْ is tawkīd (emphasis).

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿أُولَئِكَ عَلَى هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾ the triumphant.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ﴾ i.e. such of it as distracts from what matters, ﴿لِيَضِلَّ﴾ with fatḥa on the yāʾ and with ḍamma [لِيُضِلَّ] ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ the way of Islam ﴿بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا﴾ in the accusative, conjoined to يُضِلَّ, and in the nominative, conjoined to يَشْتَرِي, ﴿هُزُوًا﴾ an object of mockery; ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ﴾ involving humiliation.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا﴾ i.e. the Qurʾān, ﴿وَلَّى مُسْتَكْبِرًا﴾ arrogant, ﴿كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا﴾ deafness — the two clauses of comparison are two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the pronoun of وَلَّى, or the second is an explanation (bayān) of the first — ﴿فَبَشِّرْهُ﴾ inform him ﴿بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ﴾ painful; the mention of «glad tidings» is mockery of him. He is al-Naḍr ibn al-Ḥārith: he used to go to al-Ḥīra to trade, and would buy books of the stories of the Persians and relate them to the people of Mecca, saying: Muḥammad tells you the stories of ʿĀd and Thamūd, and I tell you the stories of Persia and Byzantium. They found his talk pleasing and abandoned listening to the Qurʾān.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا﴾ an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), i.e. their abiding in it being destined when they enter it; ﴿وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا﴾ i.e. Allah has promised them that, and made it true, truly; ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ whom nothing overcomes so as to prevent Him from fulfilling His promise and His threat, ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ who puts nothing anywhere but in its proper place.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا﴾ i.e. the pillars — ʿamad is the plural of ʿimād, which is a column — and this holds true if there are no pillars at all; ﴿وَأَلْقَى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ﴾ lofty mountains, so ﴿أَنْ﴾ [it may] not ﴿تَمِيدَ﴾ shake ﴿بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ وَأَنْزَلْنَا﴾ in it is iltifāt (a shift of person) away from the third person, ﴿مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ﴾ fine kind.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿هَذَا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. what He has created; ﴿فَأَرُونِي﴾ tell me, O people of Mecca, ﴿مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ other than Him, i.e. your gods, such that you associate them with Him, exalted is He. مَا is an interrogative of disapproving denial and a mubtadaʾ (subject); ذَا, in the sense of «that which» (alladhī), with its ṣila (relative clause), is its khabar (predicate); أَرُونِي is suspended (muʿallaq) from governing, and what follows it stands in place of the two objects. ﴿بَلِ﴾ for transition: ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ clear, through their associating partners, and you are among them.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ﴾ including knowledge, religiousness and correctness in speech; his wise sayings are many and handed down. He used to give legal opinions before the mission of David, lived to see his mission, took knowledge from him and gave up giving legal opinions; he said about that: shall I not be content when I have been spared [the need]? And he was asked: which of people is worst? He said: the one who does not care if people see him doing evil. ﴿أَنِ﴾ i.e. and We said to him: ﴿اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ﴾ for the wisdom He has given you; ﴿وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ because the reward of his thanks is his; ﴿وَمَنْ كَفَرَ﴾ the blessing, ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ﴾ independent of His creation, ﴿حَمِيدٌ﴾ praised in His making.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَ﴾ mention ﴿إِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَا بُنَيَّ﴾ a diminutive of tenderness, ﴿لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ﴾ with Allah ﴿لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾ — so he turned back to him and submitted to Islam.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ﴾ We commanded him to be dutiful to them; ﴿حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ﴾ and she weakened ﴿وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ﴾ i.e. she grew weak from the pregnancy, weak from the labour pains and weak from the birth, ﴿وَفِصَالُهُ﴾ i.e. his weaning, ﴿فِي عَامَيْنِ﴾ and We said to him: ﴿أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ﴾ i.e. the return.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ﴾ in accordance with reality, ﴿فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا﴾ i.e. with what is right — kindness and maintaining ties — ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ﴾ the way ﴿مَنْ أَنَابَ﴾ has turned back ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ in obedience; ﴿ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ and I will requite you for it. The clause of the injunction and what follows it is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍ).

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّهَا﴾ i.e. the evil deed, ﴿إِنْ تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ i.e. in the most hidden place of that, ﴿يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ﴾ and He will call to account for it; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ﴾ in bringing it out, ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾ of its place.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَوةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ﴾ because of commanding and forbidding; ﴿إِنَّ ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ﴾ i.e. of the matters resolved upon, which one resolves upon because they are obligatory.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ﴾ — in one reading [تُصَاعِرْ] — ﴿خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ﴾ do not turn your face away from them out of arrogance, ﴿وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا﴾ i.e. conceitedly; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ﴾ strutting in his walk, ﴿فَخُورٍ﴾ over people.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ﴾ be moderate in it, between creeping and hurrying, and keep to calm and dignity; ﴿وَاغْضُضْ﴾ lower ﴿مِنْ صَوْتِكَ إِنَّ أَنْكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ﴾ the ugliest of them ﴿لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ﴾ its beginning is a braying out and its end a braying in.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَوْا﴾ know, O you addressed, ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ﴾ the sun, the moon and the stars, that you may benefit from them, ﴿وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ fruits, rivers and beasts, ﴿وَأَسْبَغَ﴾ has made ample and complete ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً﴾ which is beauty of form, the proportioning of the limbs and so on, ﴿وَبَاطِنَةً﴾ it is knowledge [of Allah] and other things? ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى﴾ from a messenger ﴿وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ﴾ sent down by Allah, but rather out of blind imitation (taqlīd).

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا﴾. He, exalted is He, said: ﴿أَ﴾ would they follow it ﴿وَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ﴾ i.e. to what brings it about? No.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. devotes himself to His obedience, ﴿وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ﴾ affirming His oneness, ﴿فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى﴾ the firmest end, which there is no fear of breaking; ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ﴾ their return.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ﴾ O Muḥammad, ﴿كُفْرُهُ﴾ do not be concerned with his unbelief; ﴿إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾ i.e. of what is in them, as of other things, and so He will requite it.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿نُمَتِّعُهُمْ﴾ in this world ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ the days of their life, ﴿ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ﴾ in the Hereafter ﴿إِلَى عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ﴾ which is the punishment of the Fire; they will find no escape from it.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the lām of oath ﴿سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ﴾ — the nūn of the indicative (nūn al-rafʿ) has been dropped from it because of the succession of like letters, and the wāw of the pronoun because of the meeting of two quiescent letters — ﴿قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ for the manifestation of the proof against them for the oneness of Allah; ﴿بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ that it is obligatory upon them.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ as possession, creation and servants, so none but He deserves worship in them; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ﴾ independent of His creation, ﴿الْحَمِيدُ﴾ the one praised in His making.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ﴾ conjoined to the noun (ism) of أَنَّ [وَالْبَحْرَ] ﴿يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ﴾ as ink, ﴿مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ﴾ by which what He knows is expressed — by writing them with those pens and that ink, nor with more than that, because what He knows, exalted is He, is without limit; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ﴾ nothing is beyond His power, ﴿حَكِيمٌ﴾ nothing goes outside His knowledge and His wisdom.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ﴾ in creating and resurrecting, because it is by the word «Be», and it is; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ﴾ hears everything that can be heard, ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾ sees everything that can be seen; nothing distracts Him from anything.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ know, O you addressed, ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ﴾ makes enter ﴿اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ﴾ makes it enter ﴿فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾ so each of them increases by what is decreased from the other, ﴿وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ﴾ of them ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ in its orbit ﴿إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ which is the Day of Resurrection, ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ﴾?

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned is ﴿بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ﴾ the firmly established, ﴿وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ﴾ read with yāʾ and with tāʾ: they worship ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ الْبَاطِلُ﴾ the vanishing, ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ﴾ over His creation by subjugation, ﴿الْكَبِيرُ﴾ the mighty.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the ships ﴿تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُمْ﴾ O you addressed, by that, ﴿مِنْ آيَاتِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ﴾ lessons ﴿لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ﴾ in refraining from acts of disobedience to Allah, ﴿شَكُورٍ﴾ for His blessing.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُمْ﴾ i.e. rose over the unbelievers ﴿مَوْجٌ كَالظُّلَلِ﴾ like mountains that overshadow whoever is beneath them, ﴿دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ﴾ i.e. the supplication that He save them, i.e. they do not call on anyone else with Him; ﴿فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ﴾ midway between unbelief and faith, and among them is one who remains in his unbelief; ﴿وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا﴾ — among them the rescue from the waves — ﴿إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ﴾ treacherous one, ﴿كَفُورٍ﴾ ungrateful for the blessings of Allah the Exalted.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾ i.e. people of Mecca, ﴿اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا لَا يَجْزِي﴾ avail ﴿وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ﴾ in it anything, ﴿وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ﴾ in it ﴿شَيْئًا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ﴾ of the Resurrection, ﴿فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا﴾ away from Islam, ﴿وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ﴾ in His forbearance and His granting respite ﴿الْغَرُورُ﴾ the devil.

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ﴾ when it will come; ﴿وَيُنْزِلُ﴾ read without and with doubling [وَيُنَزِّلُ] ﴿الْغَيْثَ﴾ at a time He knows, ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ﴾ whether male or female — and none but Allah the Exalted knows any one of these three; ﴿وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا﴾ of good or evil, and Allah the Exalted knows it; ﴿وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ﴾ and Allah the Exalted knows it; ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ﴾ of everything, ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾ of its inward as of its outward. Al-Bukhārī narrated from Ibn ʿUmar the hadith: "The keys of the unseen are five: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ to the end of the sūra."
